decision_conditions: The proposed car port, by virtue of its siting, size, scale and material finish, would create a large, disproportionate and obtrusive building, which would dominate the front of the dwelling and fail to appear subservient to it. The proposed car port would represent a prominent and incongruous feature to the front of the property which, set forward of the front build line, would not accord with the established pattern or grain of development in the area. As such, the proposal would have a detrimental impact upon the character and appearance of the dwelling, as well as the street scene of Moor Park Road as well as causing harm to the significance of the Dene Road Area of Special Local Character. The proposed development therefore fails to have due regard for Local and National Planning Policy, and would be in direct conflict with Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (2012), Policies DMHB 5, DMHB 11, DMHD1 and DMHD 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Tw
